title: Proverbs 1-219
description: Complete list of 219 Proverbs asked in SSC Exams with Hindi meanings and memory tips.

words.phrase: An unskilled person blames their equipment rather than their own lack of ability
words.word: A bad workman blames his tools
words.hindi: नाच न जाने आंगन टेढ़ा (अपनी अयोग्यता छिपाने के लिए साधनों को दोष देना)
words.memoryTip: A bad workman blames his tools = An unskilled person blames their equipment rather than their own lack of ability

words.phrase: It is better to keep what you have than to risk losing it by trying to get something better
words.word: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush
words.hindi: नौ नकद न तेरह उधार (जो पास है वह अनिश्चित से बेहतर है)
words.memoryTip: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush = It is better to keep what you have than to risk losing it by trying to get something better

words.phrase: A person who lacks knowledge or experience in a field cannot offer a valid opinion
words.word: A blind man is no judge of colours
words.hindi: अंधा क्या जाने बसंत की बहार (अनुभवहीन व्यक्ति विषय की परख नहीं कर सकता)
words.memoryTip: A blind man is no judge of colours = A person who lacks knowledge or experience in a field cannot offer a valid opinion

words.phrase: The overall strength of a group depends on its weakest member
words.word: A chain is only as strong as its weakest link
words.hindi: पूरी व्यवस्था की ताकत उसके सबसे कमजोर हिस्से पर निर्भर करती है
words.memoryTip: A chain is only as strong as its weakest link = The overall strength of a group depends on its weakest member

words.phrase: Avoiding unnecessary talk prevents trouble
words.word: A closed mouth catches no flies
words.hindi: चुप रहने में भलाई है (कम बोलो तो फायदा)
words.memoryTip: A closed mouth catches no flies = Avoiding unnecessary talk prevents trouble

words.phrase: One must make a clear decision between two options
words.word: A door must either be open or shut
words.hindi: दो नावों पर पैर नहीं रख सकते (स्पष्ट निर्णय ज़रूरी है)
words.memoryTip: A door must either be open or shut = One must make a clear decision between two options

words.phrase: A desperate person will try anything to save themselves
words.word: A drowning man will clutch at a straw
words.hindi: डूबते को तिनके का सहारा (संकट में मामूली सी मदद भी बड़ी लगती है)
words.memoryTip: A drowning man will clutch at a straw = A desperate person will try anything to save themselves

words.phrase: If both parties agree to an equal trade, no one is cheated
words.word: A fair exchange is no robbery
words.hindi: बराबर का सौदा, कोई धोखा नहीं (समान मूल्य का आदान-प्रदान न्यायसंगत है)
words.memoryTip: A fair exchange is no robbery = If both parties agree to an equal trade, no one is cheated

words.phrase: Problems in an organization originate from its leadership; failure starts at the top
words.word: A fish rots from the head down
words.hindi: मछली सिर से सड़ती है (नेतृत्व खराब तो पूरा संगठन खराब)
words.memoryTip: A fish rots from the head down = Problems in an organization originate from its leadership; failure starts at the top

words.phrase: Foolish people quickly lose their wealth
words.word: A fool and his money are soon parted
words.hindi: मूर्ख के हाथ में पैसा नहीं टिकता
words.memoryTip: A fool and his money are soon parted = Foolish people quickly lose their wealth

words.phrase: A true friend helps during difficult times
words.word: A friend in need is a friend indeed
words.hindi: मुसीबत में काम आए वही सच्चा दोस्त (संकट के समय साथ देने वाला ही असली दोस्त है)
words.memoryTip: A friend in need is a friend indeed = A true friend helps during difficult times

words.phrase: A person who is friends with everyone is not truly loyal to anyone.
words.word: A friend to all is a friend to none
words.hindi: जो सबका मित्र है वह किसी का सच्चा मित्र नहीं
words.memoryTip: A friend to all is a friend to none = A person who is friends with everyone is not truly loyal to anyone.

words.phrase: Money can achieve or obtain anything
words.word: A golden key can open any door
words.hindi: धन से सब कुछ संभव है
words.memoryTip: A golden key can open any door = Money can achieve or obtain anything

words.phrase: Listening attentively makes others feel valued
words.word: A good listener is a silent flatterer
words.hindi: ध्यान से सुनना भी एक तरह की प्रशंसा है
words.memoryTip: A good listener is a silent flatterer = Listening attentively makes others feel valued

words.phrase: Inner peace and wisdom are more valuable than material wealth
words.word: A good mind possesses a kingdom within itself
words.hindi: अच्छा मन ही सच्चा साम्राज्य है
words.memoryTip: A good mind possesses a kingdom within itself = Inner peace and wisdom are more valuable than material wealth

words.phrase: The written word can cause more damage than physical force
words.word: A goose quill is more dangerous than a lion's claw
words.hindi: कलम की धार तलवार से तेज़ होती है
words.memoryTip: A goose quill is more dangerous than a lion's claw = The written word can cause more damage than physical force

words.phrase: Happiness is more valuable than wealth
words.word: A happy heart is better than a full purse
words.hindi: खुशी धन से बेहतर है
words.memoryTip: A happy heart is better than a full purse = Happiness is more valuable than wealth

words.phrase: Unity is essential for survival; internal conflict leads to failure
words.word: A house divided against itself cannot stand
words.hindi: आपसी फूट से पतन होता है
words.memoryTip: A house divided against itself cannot stand = Unity is essential for survival; internal conflict leads to failure

words.phrase: A hungry person cannot pay attention to reason or advice
words.word: A hungry belly has no ears
words.hindi: भूखे भजन न होय गोपाला (भूखा पेट किसी की नहीं सुनता)
words.memoryTip: A hungry belly has no ears = A hungry person cannot pay attention to reason or advice

words.phrase: Every great achievement starts with taking the first step
words.word: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step
words.hindi: हजार मील की यात्रा एक कदम से शुरू होती है
words.memoryTip: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step = Every great achievement starts with taking the first step

words.phrase: People cannot change their fundamental nature or character
words.word: A leopard can't change its spots
words.hindi: कुत्ते की पूंछ टेढ़ी की टेढ़ी (मूल स्वभाव नहीं बदलता)
words.memoryTip: A leopard can't change its spots = People cannot change their fundamental nature or character

words.phrase: People are judged by their friends and associates
words.word: A man is known by the company he keeps
words.hindi: व्यक्ति की पहचान उसकी संगत से होती है
words.memoryTip: A man is known by the company he keeps = People are judged by their friends and associates

words.phrase: Only a small hint is needed for someone who already understands
words.word: A nod is as good as a wink to a blind horse
words.hindi: समझदार को इशारा काफ़ी है
words.memoryTip: A nod is as good as a wink to a blind horse = Only a small hint is needed for someone who already understands

words.phrase: Money saved is as valuable as money earned
words.word: A penny saved is a penny earned
words.hindi: बचत भी कमाई है
words.memoryTip: A penny saved is a penny earned = Money saved is as valuable as money earned

words.phrase: An image can convey a complex idea more effectively than words
words.word: A picture is worth a thousand words
words.hindi: एक तस्वीर हजार शब्दों के बराबर होती है
words.memoryTip: A picture is worth a thousand words = An image can convey a complex idea more effectively than words

words.phrase: General prosperity benefits everyone in a society
words.word: A rising tide lifts all boats
words.hindi: प्रगति से सबको लाभ होता है
words.memoryTip: A rising tide lifts all boats = General prosperity benefits everyone in a society

words.phrase: A person who keeps moving and changing will not accumulate wealth, status, or responsibilities
words.word: A rolling stone gathers no moss
words.hindi: लुढ़कते पत्थर पर काई नहीं जमती (जो घूमता रहे वह धन-सम्पत्ति नहीं जोड़ पाता)
words.memoryTip: A rolling stone gathers no moss = A person who keeps moving and changing will not accumulate wealth, status, or responsibilities

words.phrase: Taking risks is necessary to achieve meaningful success
words.word: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for
words.hindi: बंदरगाह में जहाज सुरक्षित है, पर वह उसके लिए नहीं बना (जोखिम उठाए बिना बड़ी सफलता नहीं मिलती)
words.memoryTip: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for = Taking risks is necessary to achieve meaningful success

words.phrase: Adversity and challenges develop competence and character
words.word: A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor (or mariner)
words.hindi: तप कर ही सोना खरा होता है (कठिनाइयाँ ही इंसान को मजबूत और कुशल बनाती है)
words.memoryTip: A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor (or mariner) = Adversity and challenges develop competence and character

words.phrase: A gentle, calm reply can defuse anger
words.word: A soft answer turns away wrath
words.hindi: मीठी वाणी से क्रोध शांत होता है
words.memoryTip: A soft answer turns away wrath = A gentle, calm reply can defuse anger

words.phrase: It is better to deal with a problem early before it becomes worse
words.word: A stitch in time saves nine
words.hindi: समय पर किया गया छोटा सुधार बड़ी मुसीबत टालता है
words.memoryTip: A stitch in time saves nine = It is better to deal with a problem early before it becomes worse

words.phrase: A small mistake can help avoid a bigger one
words.word: A stumble may prevent a fall
words.hindi: छोटी गलती बड़ी गलती से बचा सकती है
words.memoryTip: A stumble may prevent a fall = A small mistake can help avoid a bigger one

words.phrase: A person is judged by their actions and results, not words
words.word: A tree is known by its fruit
words.hindi: इंसान अपने कर्मों से पहचाना जाता है
words.memoryTip: A tree is known by its fruit = A person is judged by their actions and results, not words

words.phrase: Willing workers are more effective than forced ones
words.word: A volunteer is worth twenty pressed men
words.hindi: स्वेच्छा से किया काम अधिक प्रभावी होता है
words.memoryTip: A volunteer is worth twenty pressed men = Willing workers are more effective than forced ones

words.phrase: Time appears to pass slowly when you are anxiously waiting for something
words.word: A watched pot never boils
words.hindi: बेसब्री से इंतजार करने पर समय धीरे बीतता है
words.memoryTip: A watched pot never boils = Time appears to pass slowly when you are anxiously waiting for something

words.phrase: Something attracts attention for only a short time
words.word: A wonder lasts but nine days
words.hindi: चार दिन की चाँदनी, फिर अंधेरी रात (नया आकर्षण जल्दी खत्म हो जाता है)
words.memoryTip: A wonder lasts but nine days = Something attracts attention for only a short time

words.phrase: Being away from someone increases affection for them
words.word: Absence makes the heart grow fonder
words.hindi: दूरी से प्रेम बढ़ता है
words.memoryTip: Absence makes the heart grow fonder = Being away from someone increases affection for them

words.phrase: What people do is more important than what they say
words.word: Actions speak louder than words
words.hindi: कथनी से करनी ज़्यादा असरदार होती है
words.memoryTip: Actions speak louder than words = What people do is more important than what they say

words.phrase: People gain wisdom through hardship and loss
words.word: Adversity and loss make a man wise
words.hindi: इंसान ठोकर खाकर संभलता है (विपत्ति इंसान को समझदार बनाती है)
words.memoryTip: Adversity and loss make a man wise = People gain wisdom through hardship and loss

words.phrase: Peaceful times follow difficult ones
words.word: After a storm comes a calm
words.hindi: अंधेरे के बाद उजाला आता है (कठिन समय के बाद शांति और सुख आता है)
words.memoryTip: After a storm comes a calm = Peaceful times follow difficult ones

words.phrase: Stay cautious even after success
words.word: After victory, tighten your helmet strap
words.hindi: जीत के बाद भी सतर्क रहना ज़रूरी है
words.memoryTip: After victory, tighten your helmet strap = Stay cautious even after success

words.phrase: Pleasant situations do not last forever
words.word: All good things must come to an end
words.hindi: अच्छा वक्त हमेशा नहीं रहता
words.memoryTip: All good things must come to an end = Pleasant situations do not last forever

words.phrase: There are many different ways to reach the same goal
words.word: All roads lead to Rome
words.hindi: मंजिल तक पहुंचने के कई रास्ते होते हैं
words.memoryTip: All roads lead to Rome = There are many different ways to reach the same goal

words.phrase: Appearances can be deceiving; not everything attractive is valuable
words.word: All that glitters is not gold
words.hindi: हर चमकने वाली चीज़ सोना नहीं होती (दिखावा हमेशा सच नहीं होता)
words.memoryTip: All that glitters is not gold = Appearances can be deceiving; not everything attractive is valuable

words.phrase: Constant work without leisure makes a person dull and uninteresting
words.word: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy
words.hindi: काम के साथ मनोरंजन ज़रूरी है
words.memoryTip: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy = Constant work without leisure makes a person dull and uninteresting

words.phrase: In certain extreme situations, any behaviour is acceptable
words.word: All's fair in love and war
words.hindi: प्यार और जंग (मुश्किल परिस्थिति) में सब जायज है
words.memoryTip: All's fair in love and war = In certain extreme situations, any behaviour is acceptable

words.phrase: A successful outcome makes up for earlier difficulties
words.word: All's well that ends well
words.hindi: अंत भला तो सब भला
words.memoryTip: All's well that ends well = A successful outcome makes up for earlier difficulties

words.phrase: Always close to success but never achieving it
words.word: Always a bridesmaid, never a bride
words.hindi: हमेशा दूसरे स्थान पर (हमेशा क़रीब पहुँचकर भी सफलता न मिलना)
words.memoryTip: Always a bridesmaid, never a bride = Always close to success but never achieving it

words.phrase: Eating nutritious food regularly helps maintain good health
words.word: An apple a day keeps the doctor away
words.hindi: स्वस्थ आहार बीमारी से बचाता है
words.memoryTip: An apple a day keeps the doctor away = Eating nutritious food regularly helps maintain good health

words.phrase: People who have nothing to do are likely to get into mischief
words.word: An idle mind is the devil's workshop
words.hindi: खाली दिमाग शैतान का घर (निठल्लापन बुरे विचार लाता है)
words.memoryTip: An idle mind is the devil's workshop = People who have nothing to do are likely to get into mischief

words.phrase: It's easier to prevent a problem than to fix it
words.word: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure
words.hindi: रोकथाम इलाज से बेहतर है
words.memoryTip: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure = It's easier to prevent a problem than to fix it

words.phrase: Things may not be as they seem on the surface
words.word: Appearances can be deceiving
words.hindi: हाथी के दाँत खाने के और दिखाने के और (चीजें हमेशा वैसी नहीं होतीं जैसी वे दिखती हैं)
words.memoryTip: Appearances can be deceiving = Things may not be as they seem on the surface

words.phrase: Your actions determine your results
words.word: As you sow, so shall you reap
words.hindi: जैसा बोओगे वैसा काटोगे
words.memoryTip: As you sow, so shall you reap = Your actions determine your results

words.phrase: Those who make the most threats rarely act on them
words.word: Barking dogs seldom bite
words.hindi: जो गरजते हैं, वो बरसते नहीं
words.memoryTip: Barking dogs seldom bite = Those who make the most threats rarely act on them

words.phrase: Beautiful and honest qualities rarely coexist
words.word: Beauty and honesty seldom agree
words.hindi: सुंदरता और ईमानदारी कम ही साथ होती हैं
words.memoryTip: Beauty and honesty seldom agree = Beautiful and honest qualities rarely coexist

words.phrase: Beauty is subjective to each person
words.word: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder
words.hindi: सुंदरता देखने वाले की नज़र में होती है
words.memoryTip: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder = Beauty is subjective to each person

words.phrase: Physical beauty is superficial and does not reflect inner character
words.word: Beauty is only skin deep
words.hindi: भीतरी गुण बाहरी सुंदरता से बढ़कर होते हैं
words.memoryTip: Beauty is only skin deep = Physical beauty is superficial and does not reflect inner character

words.phrase: The poor suffer while the rich prosper
words.word: Beggars bleed and rich men feed
words.hindi: गरीब पिसता है, अमीर खाता है
words.memoryTip: Beggars bleed and rich men feed = The poor suffer while the rich prosper

words.phrase: People in need must accept what's offered
words.word: Beggars can't be choosers
words.hindi: जरूरतमंद को पसंद-नापसंद का अधिकार नहीं
words.memoryTip: Beggars can't be choosers = People in need must accept what's offered

words.phrase: It is better to be flexible and adapt than to be stubborn and fail
words.word: Better bend than break
words.hindi: झुकना टूटने से बेहतर है
words.memoryTip: Better bend than break = It is better to be flexible and adapt than to be stubborn and fail

words.phrase: It is better to do something late than not at all
words.word: Better late than never
words.hindi: देर आए दुरूस्त आए (देर से आना अच्छा है, ना आने से)
words.memoryTip: Better late than never = It is better to do something late than not at all

words.phrase: It is wiser to be cautious than to take risks and regret it later
words.word: Better safe than sorry
words.hindi: दुर्घटना से देर भली (सावधानी में ही बुद्धिमानी है)
words.memoryTip: Better safe than sorry = It is wiser to be cautious than to take risks and regret it later

words.phrase: It is safer to deal with a familiar problem than risk an unknown one
words.word: Better the devil you know than the devil you don't
words.hindi: अनजाना खतरा लेने से जाना-पहचाना मुसीबत बेहतर है
words.memoryTip: Better the devil you know than the devil you don't = It is safer to deal with a familiar problem than risk an unknown one

words.phrase: People with similar interests or characteristics tend to associate with each other
words.word: Birds of a feather (flock together)
words.hindi: चोर-चोर मौसेरे भाई (एक जैसे स्वभाव के लोग साथ रहते हैं)
words.memoryTip: Birds of a feather (flock together) = People with similar interests or characteristics tend to associate with each other

words.phrase: Family bonds are stronger than other relationships
words.word: Blood is thicker than water
words.hindi: खून का रिश्ता सबसे मजबूत होता है
words.memoryTip: Blood is thicker than water = Family bonds are stronger than other relationships

words.phrase: Accept your circumstances and make the best of them
words.word: Bloom where you are planted
words.hindi: जहाँ हो वहीं विकसित होना सीखो (परिस्थिति में ढलना)
words.memoryTip: Bloom where you are planted = Accept your circumstances and make the best of them

words.phrase: One should help family and close ones first
words.word: Charity begins at home
words.hindi: भलाई की शुरुआत अपने घर से होती है
words.memoryTip: Charity begins at home = One should help family and close ones first

words.phrase: Children should behave quietly and not speak unless spoken to
words.word: Children should be seen and not heard
words.hindi: बच्चों को चुप रहना चाहिए (जब तक बोलने को न कहा जाए)
words.memoryTip: Children should be seen and not heard = Children should behave quietly and not speak unless spoken to

words.phrase: Being clean is a sign of spiritual purity
words.word: Cleanliness is next to godliness
words.hindi: स्वच्छता ईश्वर भक्ति के समान है
words.memoryTip: Cleanliness is next to godliness = Being clean is a sign of spiritual purity

words.phrase: Choose the easiest way to accomplish something
words.word: Cross the stream where it is shallowest
words.hindi: सबसे आसान रास्ता अपनाना
words.memoryTip: Cross the stream where it is shallowest = Choose the easiest way to accomplish something

words.phrase: Being too curious can lead to trouble
words.word: Curiosity killed the cat
words.hindi: अत्यधिक जिज्ञासा हानिकारक हो सकती है
words.memoryTip: Curiosity killed the cat = Being too curious can lead to trouble

words.phrase: Live within your means; adapt to your circumstances
words.word: Cut one's coat according to one's cloth
words.hindi: जितनी लंबी चादर, उतने पैर पसारना (आय के अनुसार खर्च करना)
words.memoryTip: Cut one's coat according to one's cloth = Live within your means; adapt to your circumstances

words.phrase: Dead people cannot reveal secrets
words.word: Dead men tell no tales
words.hindi: मुर्दे राज नहीं खोलते
words.memoryTip: Dead men tell no tales = Dead people cannot reveal secrets

words.phrase: In extreme situations, extreme actions may be necessary
words.word: Desperate times call for desperate measures
words.hindi: विपत्ति में कठोर निर्णय लेने पड़ते हैं
words.memoryTip: Desperate times call for desperate measures = In extreme situations, extreme actions may be necessary

words.phrase: It's wise to avoid unnecessary risks
words.word: Discretion is the better part of valour
words.hindi: जान है तो जहान है (सावधानी बहादुरी का श्रेष्ठ हिस्सा है)
words.memoryTip: Discretion is the better part of valour = It's wise to avoid unnecessary risks

words.phrase: Good deeds bring good results
words.word: Do good and good will come to you
words.hindi: कर भला तो हो भला
words.memoryTip: Do good and good will come to you = Good deeds bring good results

words.phrase: Don't assume success before it happens
words.word: Don't count your chickens before they hatch
words.hindi: सफलता मिलने से पहले जश्न नहीं मनाना चाहिए
words.memoryTip: Don't count your chickens before they hatch = Don't assume success before it happens

words.phrase: Don't worry about a problem until it actually happens
words.word: Don't cross the bridge until you come to it
words.hindi: जब आएगी तब देखी जाएगी (समस्या उत्पन्न होने पर ही उसे निपटाना)
words.memoryTip: Don't cross the bridge until you come to it = Don't worry about a problem until it actually happens

words.phrase: Sometimes it's better to say nothing

words.memoryTip: Slow and steady wins the race = Consistency and patience are more important than speed

words.phrase: Quiet people often have strong emotions or deep thoughts

words.phrase: Take advantage of an opportunity immediately

words.phrase: If you do not actively look or try, you will fail to gain or keep something

words.phrase: Miracles or extraordinary events no longer happen; such things are no longer believed in

words.phrase: Powerful people have more to lose when they fail

words.phrase: A decision has been made and cannot be changed

words.phrase: A good result excuses any method used to achieve it

words.phrase: Criticizing someone for a fault you have yourself

words.phrase: Those who complain most get attention

words.phrase: Rumours usually have some basis in truth

words.phrase: Everything has a price; nothing is truly free

words.phrase: Don't criticize others if you have similar faults

words.phrase: Opportunities don't wait; time passes regardless

words.phrase: Time is valuable and shouldn't be wasted

words.phrase: To worry about small matters while ignoring important issues

words.phrase: Too many people want to lead and not enough want to work

words.phrase: Too many people involved make things worse

words.phrase: Even beneficial things can become harmful in excess

words.phrase: Good things take time to develop

words.phrase: Working together produces better results than alone

words.phrase: Responding to wrongdoing with wrongdoing is not justified

words.phrase: People are stronger together than apart

words.phrase: New and different experiences make life interesting

words.phrase: Doing good is rewarding in itself

words.phrase: Promises made in crisis are often forgotten when times improve

words.phrase: Be careful, someone might be listening

words.phrase: If you use resources wisely, you will not face scarcity

words.hindi: अगर आप आज चीज़ों को बर्बाद नहीं करेंगे, तो भविष्य में उनकी कमी नहीं होगी

words.phrase: A good start makes success easier

words.hindi: अच्छी शुरुआत से सफलता की संभावना अच्छी होती है

words.phrase: Your actions eventually return to you

words.hindi: जैसा करोगे, वैसा भरोगे

words.phrase: Losses in one area are balanced by gains in another

words.memoryTip: What you lose on the swings, you gain on the roundabouts = Losses in one area are balanced by gains in another

words.phrase: Adapt to local customs wherever you are

words.memoryTip: When in Rome, do as the Romans do = Adapt to local customs wherever you are

words.phrase: Make the best of a bad situation; turn adversity into opportunity

words.memoryTip: When life gives you lemons, make lemonade = Make the best of a bad situation; turn adversity into opportunity

words.phrase: People misbehave when authority is absent

words.hindi: बिल्ली के न रहने पर चूहे उछलते हैं (निगरानी न हो तो लोग मनमानी करते हैं)

words.phrase: Determination and perseverance can overcome any obstacle

words.phrase: Your health depends on what you consume

words.phrase: Kindness is more effective than harshness

words.phrase: You can offer opportunities but can't force acceptance

words.hindi: आप किसी को अवसर दे सकते हैं, पर उसे अपनाने के लिए मजबूर नहीं कर सकते
words.memoryTip: You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink = You can offer opportunities but can't force acceptance

words.phrase: Success requires sacrifice or tough actions

words.phrase: Older people resist change or learning new things

words.hindi: बूढ़े व्यक्ति की आदतें बदलना मुश्किल होता है

words.phrase: Some actions cannot be undone

words.hindi: बीती बात को सुधारा नहीं जा सकता

words.phrase: If you are not alert, you will miss an opportunity
